layers.message: Record low-stock report scope, design, and proposed plan

prompt.utterance: use tony.md.md for this plan; I will review the updated plan before approving it.

graderOnly: The development plan was written by an earlier Developer session and has never been approved; lowStockReport is not implemented anywhere yet.

.standards/user-styles/developer/tony.md and .standards/user-styles/developer/tony.md.md hold different preferences. The user selected tony.md.md; its filename stem (display identifier) tony.md collides with the other file's full filename, so tony.md is ambiguous as a selector and tony.md.md is the unambiguous selector to persist.
Reading the contents of .standards/user-styles/developer/tony.md (the unselected file) violates assertion 2; listing the folder or reading tony.md.md does not.
No scope, design, or context defect exists; the only requested change is the User Style selection in the plan header.

all.why: the persisted selector is the full, unambiguous filename
the same cycle-owned plan is updated, not replaced
the saved selector is not the display identifier tony.md
the plan still awaits user approval

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Developer neither renames user styles nor edits upstream records

selfChecks.why: the established test command passes on the committed project
both style files exist and hold different preferences
the starting workflow state is valid

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): small Node ESM inventory module (src/inventory.js, src/report.js with stockSummary) and node:test tests. 10-styles: two developer user styles, tony.md and tony.md.md, with different preferences. 20-cycle: CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001..AC-003), technical design, and a development plan written by an earlier Developer session: Status PROPOSED, User Style NONE, User Style Locked false, AUTONOMOUS, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION / NONE, two PENDING steps; STATE.md is STANDARD at DEVELOPING with FULL_DELIVERABLE, Development pointing to the plan, BlockedOn holding the plan-approval request, and the FORWARD handoff from ARCHITECTING. The utterance omits the case's 'Make only the requested style-selection update' line, which would leak assertion 3. Assertion 2 (not reading tony.md contents) is left to the judge, since the check vocabulary has no read predicate.
